subject: Taxes
title: The Crypto Question on Form 1040
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Crypto Question on Form 1040.

hook.text: In 2020, the IRS added a crypto question atop Form 1040, asking if you sold or exchanged any virtual currency.

buildup.text: Placing it at the top of the return—right after name and address—was deliberate. It's impossible to miss or ignore.

discovery.text: Lying on a tax return is perjury. The question turned crypto non-reporting from negligence into a potential crime.

twist.text: The question was modeled after the foreign bank account checkbox.

climax.text: One checkbox transformed crypto from a gray area to a clear legal obligation.

punchline.text: One question on page one. The IRS made crypto tax ignorance legally impossible.

quiz.question: When did the IRS add a crypto question to Form 1040?
